Subject: Recap and quick asks from today's demo — security path and timeline

Hi Alice — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and the asks I promised to follow up on: 

1) Forms: you mentioned your security team prefers a SIG-lite flow but will accept CAIQ if needed. Can you confirm whether we should: (A) start with the SIG-lite prefill, (B) send the full CAIQ, or (C) use your custom questionnaire? If FinancialCare has a vendor portal, point me to it and we'll upload.

2) SOC 2: we're SOC 2 Type II in scope for our SaaS tenant with a recent audit completed earlier this year. I attached a redacted SOC 2 summary (high level) — will that be sufficient for the procurement review, or does your team need the full report under NDA?

3) Data residency / compliance: please confirm if HIPAA is required for the integration (you indicated some workflows may be PHI). Also confirm whether EU residency or GDPR-specific controls are required for any subset of data.

4) Evidence and timeline: what's your target date to finish the security intake? We can prefill SIG fields and assign an internal owner to accelerate.

Next steps I propose: once you confirm the preferred form, I'll share a prefilled SIG-lite spreadsheet and assign Rishi as the evidence owner for tech artifacts and Monica for SOC/dataflow questions.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_summary_redacted.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — Ben

Hi Ben — great demo, thanks. Quick answers below: 

- Form: our InfoSec team prefers SIG-Lite for third-party SaaS vendors for initial intake. If the SIG-Lite prefill looks complete we'll escalate only if there are gaps. Please send the prefill spreadsheet.
- SOC 2: the summary looks ok as a first pass. For procurement we typically request the full report under NDA before contracting; I'll confirm internally whether summary + evidence is sufficient to proceed to commercial review.
- HIPAA: yes — FinancialCare will be processing PHI for the pilot. We need to validate BAA coverage and some of the dataflow artifacts.
- Residency/GDPR: not required for the initial US pilot. We may revisit for EU plans.
- Timeline: target to complete intake in 2 weeks (by Oct 22) to keep contract timing on track.

Point of contact from our side: security@financialcare.com (please include this alias on all uploads).

Thanks —
Alice Wu
Head of Product, Integrations
FinancialCare Inc.
